title: Keep authoring file reads and writes inside the project through symlinks
description:
Audit key: S03
Evidence class: confirmed
Baseline: f6ca003f255fe7636e97d63ba80e4bfcd9cffa32 (2026-09-30 Australia/Sydney)
Sources: internal/dev/server.go:sourcePath/handleFile/writeSource/handleLivePreview; internal/dev/mcp.go

Evidence:
Black-box dev API: GET content/linked/outside.md returns an external sentinel, and PUT content/linked/new.md returns 200 and creates an external file. linked is a directory symlink. sourcePath currently validates only lexical paths.

Scope: Test/fix/optimise existing behaviour only. Record reproduction, changed paths, tests, measurements and commit in notes; maintain CHANGELOG.md. Unproven candidates can be resolved with a documented measurement-based no-change decision.
acceptance_criteria: Use a shared confined file boundary for REST and MCP reads, writes, previews and uploads. Reject external parent/final symlinks before reading or creating files; cover non-existent targets, existing links, authenticated remote mode and read-only mode. External sentinels never change.

title: Prevent build and clean from deleting source, state or external directories
description:
Audit key: S01
Evidence class: confirmed
Baseline: f6ca003f255fe7636e97d63ba80e4bfcd9cffa32 (2026-09-30 Australia/Sydney)
Sources: internal/site/build.go:safeOutput; cmd/mpress/main.go:clean; internal/config/config.go

Evidence:
Disposable CLI reproductions: outputDir=content and outputDir=static both exit 0 and delete sentinel source/assets. A symlinked parent linked/site deletes an external sentinel. Current guard checks lexical project containment only.

Scope: Test/fix/optimise existing behaviour only. Record reproduction, changed paths, tests, measurements and commit in notes; maintain CHANGELOG.md. Unproven candidates can be resolved with a documented measurement-based no-change decision.
acceptance_criteria: Validate canonical containment and disjointness from content, static, configuration, Git and persistent state BEFORE any removal. Cover equal, ancestor, descendant, symlinked and non-existent paths, override output paths and clean. Existing sentinels survive every rejection; ordinary, export and live-preview output still work.

title: Contain and normalise every generated page route
description:

Sources: internal/content/content.go:routeFor/outputFor; internal/site/render_pages.go; internal/config/config.go

acceptance_criteria: Reject dot segments, platform separators, invalid language path components, output escapes and generated-file namespace collisions before writes. Detect equivalent routes deterministically. Cover Markdown, MPD, multilingual routes and Windows path forms; source/outside sentinels remain unchanged.

acceptance_criteria: Add an explicit public browser regression gate and enforce browser/Axe prerequisites for owned release qualification. Install pinned tooling/test dependencies without adding production dependencies; fail required checks instead of skipping silently. Keep private corpus out of public logs.

title: Avoid the second full HTML pass for final asset hashes
description:
Audit key: P06
Evidence class: measured
Baseline: f6ca003f255fe7636e97d63ba80e4bfcd9cffa32 (2026-09-30 Australia/Sydney)
Sources: internal/site/build.go:rewriteAssetVersions/Build; internal/site/render_pages.go

Evidence:
Allocation profile: rewriteAssetVersions callback flat 276.6MB and cumulative 678.5MB, 22.3% of total run allocations. Build writes provisional hashes, then rereads/rewrites every HTML file after CSS optimisation.

Scope: Test/fix/optimise existing behaviour only. Record reproduction, changed paths, tests, measurements and commit in notes; maintain CHANGELOG.md. Unproven candidates can be resolved with a documented measurement-based no-change decision.
acceptance_criteria: Measure a bounded strategy for computing/filling final hashes without rereading and copying every page. Preserve custom/static HTML, version snapshots, cache URLs, purging and collector output. Prove allocations/I/O/time reduction and byte equivalence except intended hashes.

title: Reduce knowledge inverted-index token and posting allocations

Sources: internal/knowledge/artifact.go:makeIndex/tokens; internal/knowledge/store.go

Evidence:
Allocation profile: makeIndex flat 187.7MB of 3,047MB across profiled run. It retokenizes page title, route and tags per chunk, creates pointer postings and a new route replacer per chunk, and sorts per-chunk term keys.

Scope: Test/fix/optimise existing behaviour only. Record reproduction, changed paths, tests, measurements and commit in notes; maintain CHANGELOG.md. Unproven candidates can be resolved with a documented measurement-based no-change decision.
acceptance_criteria: Benchmark component/long-page/CJK corpora; reuse invariant tokens/replacer and cheaper posting storage where safe. Preserve exact postings, deterministic bytes, relevance evaluation and filters. Show before/after allocations/time, without speculative rewrites.

title: Maintain repeatable build, startup and size benchmark baselines

Sources: internal/site/build_bench_test.go; internal/mpd/benchmark_test.go; audit evidence and workload harness

acceptance_criteria: Provide pinned small/201-page/large multilingual/component-heavy workloads, command startup, wall/RSS and per-phase/allocation/size measurements. Record toolchain, CPU, options, warm/cold cache and repeated medians; keep correctness/determinism gates and comparisons on the same machine.

title: Protect custom runtime CSS classes during production purging

acceptance_criteria: Reproduce a custom script-created class, escaped selectors and modern at-rules; retain required styling conservatively while keeping demonstrably unused built-in rules removable. Preserve custom CSS contract and test purged/unpurged pages by computed styles.
notes: Disposable CLI reproduction: a custom script adds audit-runtime-created to body; strict production build copies the script but removes its custom.css rule from mpress.css. Wails currently uses --no-purge-css for its imported homepage animation.

title: Prove JavaScript and CSS minifier semantics with execution checks
description:
Audit key: C06
Evidence class: source-risk
Baseline: f6ca003f255fe7636e97d63ba80e4bfcd9cffa32 (2026-09-30 Australia/Sydney)
Sources: internal/site/minify_javascript.go; internal/site/minify_css.go; internal/site/assets.go; assets_test.go

Evidence:
assets.go describes lexical minifiers without renaming, but JS now mangles names using token heuristics. Template expressions are scanned as one token. Existing fuzzers check only panic freedom. Initial JS fuzz run terminated during minimization; saved seed replays successfully, so this is not a confirmed minifier hang.

Scope: Test/fix/optimise existing behaviour only. Record reproduction, changed paths, tests, measurements and commit in notes; maintain CHANGELOG.md. Unproven candidates can be resolved with a documented measurement-based no-change decision.
acceptance_criteria: Execute source and minified code against an engine for scoping, closures, template interpolation, shorthand keys, methods, labels, ASI, regex/division and modern syntax. Compare CSS computed styles. Reproduce any failure before classifying it; rerun isolated fuzz and preserve true regression seeds.

title: Refresh dev configuration safely and remove shared-config races
description:
Audit key: C02
Evidence class: source-risk
Baseline: f6ca003f255fe7636e97d63ba80e4bfcd9cffa32 (2026-09-30 Australia/Sydney)
Sources: internal/dev/server.go:Server.cfg/watch/rebuildLocked/handleConfig/handleTranslations; newMCPHandler

Evidence:
s.cfg is read across concurrent handlers/watch and assigned by config/translation operations without a uniform lock. rebuildLocked reloads config inside site.Build but does not refresh s.cfg or the file server. Public race tests do not stress these concurrent paths.

Scope: Test/fix/optimise existing behaviour only. Record reproduction, changed paths, tests, measurements and commit in notes; maintain CHANGELOG.md. Unproven candidates can be resolved with a documented measurement-based no-change decision.
acceptance_criteria: Run concurrent requests/config writes under race detection and external config-edit black-box tests. Serve the correct output after outputDir/language/theme changes; invalid config keeps the prior usable state. Use immutable snapshots or a clear lock contract and avoid deadlocks.

title: Make the dev watcher detect deletions, renames and non-monotonic mtimes
description:
Audit key: C01
Evidence class: source-risk
Baseline: f6ca003f255fe7636e97d63ba80e4bfcd9cffa32 (2026-09-30 Australia/Sydney)
Sources: internal/dev/server.go:watch/latest

Evidence:
watch compares only maximum regular-file ModTime and rebuilds only when next.After(last). Deleting a non-newest page or changing an older file to a timestamp below the maximum can be missed. It scans the entire project every 500ms.

Scope: Test/fix/optimise existing behaviour only. Record reproduction, changed paths, tests, measurements and commit in notes; maintain CHANGELOG.md. Unproven candidates can be resolved with a documented measurement-based no-change decision.
acceptance_criteria: Black-box edit/delete/rename/create and preserved/older-mtime changes trigger exactly the needed rebuild. Ignore output/cache/VCS/unrelated files, handle errors explicitly and debounce bursts. Measure idle work and rebuild latency on large sites.

title: Prevent heading anchors from colliding with shell control IDs
description:

Evidence class: confirmed
Baseline: f6ca003f255fe7636e97d63ba80e4bfcd9cffa32 (2026-09-30 Australia/Sydney)
Sources: internal/site/template.go; internal/site/theme_default.go selectors; internal/content/content.go heading IDs

Whole-output scan confirms duplicate IDs search, accessibility and theme on configuration/index.html. Private release scan also reports them. check currently stores IDs in a set and does not diagnose duplicates.

Scope: Test/fix/optimise existing behaviour only. Record reproduction, changed paths, tests, measurements and commit in notes; maintain CHANGELOG.md. Unproven candidates can be resolved with a documented measurement-based no-change decision.
acceptance_criteria: Give shell controls a reserved namespace or otherwise preserve unique IDs while retaining existing public heading anchors. Check all docs and locale pages, ARIA references and keyboard shortcuts. Add generated-output duplicate-ID regression coverage.

title: Assign repeated components unique deterministic instance IDs
description:

Evidence class: confirmed
Baseline: f6ca003f255fe7636e97d63ba80e4bfcd9cffa32 (2026-09-30 Australia/Sydney)
Sources: internal/components/carousel.go; internal/components/components.go:Tabs; internal/components/table.go; API playground IDs

Two identical @carousel blocks in one page produce the same mpress-carousel-a2db93368d ID. Tabs and tables also use content hashes; identical instances need explicit verification. Meta map iteration in Tabs rendering can also affect byte determinism.

Scope: Test/fix/optimise existing behaviour only. Record reproduction, changed paths, tests, measurements and commit in notes; maintain CHANGELOG.md. Unproven candidates can be resolved with a documented measurement-based no-change decision.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated identical carousels/tabs/tables/playgrounds have unique IDs and correct local ARIA relationships. IDs and output bytes remain deterministic across concurrent cold/warm builds; explicit authored IDs get clear collision diagnostics. Test independent interaction.

title: Resolve dialog Escape focus restoration failures
description:
Audit key: B05
Evidence class: test-failure
Baseline: f6ca003f255fe7636e97d63ba80e4bfcd9cffa32 (2026-09-30 Australia/Sydney)
Sources: internal/site/theme_default.go:image/contribution dialog handlers; private browser_test.go

Private image-dialog test reports FocusAfterClose empty. It opens with JS click and checks immediately after Escape, so timing and opener tracking must be distinguished. Image close handler clears content without explicit opener restoration.

Scope: Test/fix/optimise existing behaviour only. Record reproduction, changed paths, tests, measurements and commit in notes; maintain CHANGELOG.md. Unproven candidates can be resolved with a documented measurement-based no-change decision.
acceptance_criteria: Use real keyboard/pointer activation and wait for native close/focus events. Cover image and contribution dialogs, repeated opens, programmatic close, backdrop and Escape. Fix actual focus loss and repair stale/timing-sensitive expectations without weakening behaviour.

title: Verify contribution dialog scrolling and focus on phones
description:

Evidence class: source-risk

Sources: internal/site/theme_default.go:.mpress-contribute-dialog/mobile rules; contribution dialog handlers

The mobile dialog receives max-height:calc(100dvh - 1rem) while its base rule has overflow:hidden and content grows when setup/explanation is opened. Existing private test checks strings and click state, not reachability.

Scope: Test/fix/optimise existing behaviour only. Record reproduction, changed paths, tests, measurements and commit in notes; maintain CHANGELOG.md. Unproven candidates can be resolved with a documented measurement-based no-change decision.
acceptance_criteria: Open choices, local setup and explanation on 320/375px phones and short landscape. Swipe to every control, restore focus on Escape/close and retain source route in generated launcher arguments. Fix clipping only if reproduced; retain site-specific scripts.

Assert scroll deltas and background locking before/after close, with production CSS and small viewports. Keep browser dependencies out of the production binary.

title: Make closed popovers inert so mobile touch scrolling works
description:
Audit key: B01
Evidence class: confirmed
Baseline: f6ca003f255fe7636e97d63ba80e4bfcd9cffa32 (2026-09-30 Australia/Sydney)
Sources: internal/site/theme_default.go:.utility-menu-panel; internal/site/accessibility.go:.mpress-accessibility-panel

Evidence:
Real CDP touch gestures on /configuration/, /code-components/ and /data-components/ at 375x667 and 375x375 leave scrollY=0 before and after panel close. elementFromPoint hits closed opacity:0 accessibility content. Injected inert CSS restores 186-192px scrolling. Related upstream PR #6.

Scope: Test/fix/optimise existing behaviour only. Record reproduction, changed paths, tests, measurements and commit in notes; maintain CHANGELOG.md. Unproven candidates can be resolved with a documented measurement-based no-change decision.
acceptance_criteria: Closed popovers cannot intercept pointer/touch events or keyboard focus; open popovers remain interactive. Reproduce swipe/hit-testing before and after open/close, including transitions, production purged CSS and accessibility disabled. Reuse or attribute PR #6 where appropriate.

title: Keep accessibility settings reachable in short mobile viewports
description:
Audit key: B02
Evidence class: confirmed
Baseline: f6ca003f255fe7636e97d63ba80e4bfcd9cffa32 (2026-09-30 Australia/Sydney)
Sources: internal/site/accessibility.go:.mpress-accessibility-body/mobile rules; accessibilityJS panel positioning

Evidence:
At 375x375, panel clientHeight=357 while scrollHeight=528, and body min-height=400. The panel and body have nested scrolling. At 375x667 body scrolling works. This is a confirmed constrained-viewport overflow, requiring reachability regression coverage.

Scope: Test/fix/optimise existing behaviour only. Record reproduction, changed paths, tests, measurements and commit in notes; maintain CHANGELOG.md. Unproven candidates can be resolved with a documented measurement-based no-change decision.
acceptance_criteria: All tabs/settings/reset/close remain reachable by touch and keyboard in portrait, landscape and 200% text, including width/font preferences. Reduce inflexible minimum sizing and assert the actual intended scroll container and panel bounds.

title: Validate and protect every version snapshot operation
description:

Evidence class: source-risk
Baseline: f6ca003f255fe7636e97d63ba80e4bfcd9cffa32 (2026-09-30 Australia/Sydney)
Sources: internal/version/version.go:Capture/List/Verify/Remove/Mount/manifestFilePath

Capture uses dest+.tmp, removes it preemptively and removes the destination before rename; Verify joins a caller label without the Capture label validator. Manifest path checking is lexical. Public package coverage is 44.2%.

Scope: Test/fix/optimise existing behaviour only. Record reproduction, changed paths, tests, measurements and commit in notes; maintain CHANGELOG.md. Unproven candidates can be resolved with a documented measurement-based no-change decision.
acceptance_criteria: Exercise invalid labels, symlinked artifacts/manifest paths, simultaneous captures, overwrite failure, missing/extra/tampered files and read-only destinations. Reuse one label/path policy; preserve the last verified snapshot on failure and keep mounted navigation correct.

title: Preserve the last good site when a strict build fails

Evidence class: confirmed

Scope: Test/fix/optimise existing behaviour only. Record reproduction, changed paths, tests, measurements and commit in notes; maintain CHANGELOG.md. Unproven candidates can be resolved with a documented measurement-based no-change decision.
acceptance_criteria: Validate early and stage output for promotion only on success. Failed parsing, navigation, CSS/minification, copy, mount and finalization leave the prior site intact. Check collectors, timings, exports and dev serving work with staging; test promotion failure recovery.

title: Make document conversion recoverable across partial filesystem failures

acceptance_criteria: Inject target write/rename, source deletion and config/state-save failures. Preserve originals and translation state or perform verified rollback; reject target collisions and existing temporary symlinks. Successful Markdown/MPD conversions remain semantically equivalent.

title: Apply parser resource limits before large allocations

Scope: Test/fix/optimise existing behaviour only. Record reproduction, changed paths, tests, measurements and commit in notes; maintain CHANGELOG.md. Unproven candidates can be resolved with a documented measurement-based no-change decision.
acceptance_criteria: Add boundary workloads for oversized input, deep nesting, attribute count and invalid UTF-8; ensure rejection happens before avoidable allocations. Verify D2 import isolation and cancellation. Document supported limits and measure worst-case time/memory; no arbitrary feature removal.
